post.description:
Register file after uploading via pre-signed URL. This creates a file record associated with this project. Prerequisites: the actual file content is uploaded to a temporary presigned URL.
**Supported File Types:** - `pdf`: application/pdf - `csv`: text/csv - `xls`: application/vnd.ms-excel - `xlsx`: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet - `doc`: application/msword - `docx`: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document - `ppt`: application/vnd.ms-powerpoint - `pptx`: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation - `comma-separated-values`: text/comma-separated-values - `svg`: image/svg+xml - `public-svg-image`: image/svg+xml - `usdz`: model/vnd.usdz+zip - `jpeg`: image/jpeg - `jpg`: image/jpg - `pjpeg`: image/pjpeg - `png`: image/png - `x-png`: image/x-png - `gif`: image/gif - `bmp`: image/bmp - `x-windows-bmp`: image/x-windows-bmp - `webp`: image/webp

parameters.description: The ID of the project to associate the file with

examples: Restoration of the Victorian Manor, focusing on structural integrity, historical preservation, and modern utility upgrades. Aimed at conserving the manor’s architectural heritage while making it functional for contemporary use.

id.description: Identifier of the floor value entry.

symbol_id.description: The symbol_id is a string that identifies the type of element represented by the image map entry. In this case, it is `floor`, indicating that the coordinates correspond to the floor area in the plan. The symbol_id helps to categorize and differentiate between various elements in the plan, such as walls, furniture, or rooms.

id.description: Identifier of the room value entry.

value.description: Value for the given `id` in this entry of the room `values` array.

id.description: Identifier of the wall value entry.

value.description: The value corresponding to the id. For example, if the id is `width`, the value might be `4.5` (indicating 4.5m of width). If the id is `notes`, the value could be a textual description or comment. The `walls_surface` and `walls_surface_without_openings` values are wall surface areas expressed in square meters. The value is always represented as a string, even if it contains numeric or boolean data, to allow for flexibility in the type of information that can be stored.

estimate_unique_id.description: A user-facing, human-readable identifier for the estimate. This is often used in documents or reports and may follow a specific format (e.g., invoice-style numbering). It is intended for referencing estimates in a business context and can be visible to customers.

created.description: Timestamp of when the estimate was initially created, in ISO 8601 format with UTC timezone.

modified.description: Timestamp of the last modification made to the estimate, in ISO 8601 format with UTC timezone.
